The Oconee-Pickens area is largely a manufacturing region with approximately 50 percent of the work force employed in manufacturing firms. The largest employer is the textile industry, with 11,968 workers in 1970 or 50 percent of the manufacturing work force. While textiles have traditionally claimed the greater share of manufacturing employment in this area, the percent of workers in the textile industry has declined in the last 20 years as the region's industry has become more diversified (Hammer, Green, Siler: 1971a and 1971b) (Table 2-12).
